sections.text:
-Target: 1 random enemy out of all enemies. Ability Power 760. Success value 100. 10x physical damage (Fire).
Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
-Target: all enemies. Applies Scorching for 40 seconds with a success value of 180.
-Target: all allies. Reduces status ailment resistance value by 30 for 60 seconds. [Demerit]
-Target: all allies. Applies kijin (increases max HP by 100%; nullifies debuffs; nullifies Unison gauge reduction; boosts Ability Power of critical hits by 50; increases attack Ability accuracy by 30%; permits piercing through damage reduction, damage reflection, and damage nullifying effects when attacking) for 150 seconds.
-Target: yourself. Increases physical and magic attack Ability Power by 100 for 150 seconds.
-Target: yourself. Boosts critical hit Ability Power by 100 for 150 seconds.
-Target: yourself. Increases physical and magic Ability Power and Critical Assault buff limits by 50 for 150 seconds.
